custom.intro: Pick a dark or light base, a hue for the surfaces and one for the accent. The colors come from the same lightness ladder as the twelve fixed themes, and text contrast is fitted for you.
custom.inUse: In use: let go of a slider or tap a button and the whole app takes the new colors, on every device connected to this host.
custom.notInUse: Not selected yet. Choose “{name}” in Settings → Appearance → Theme, and every change here will recolor the whole app.
custom.surfaceHueHint: The color the page, cards and sidebar lean toward
custom.accentVividnessHint: 100% is the most colorful this hue allows
custom.saved: Saved on the host. Every device follows.
custom.readFailed: Could not read the saved colors: {error}

preview.label: Preview of the custom theme
preview.cardBody: 3 files to change, 2 tests to add

checks.title: Contrast
checks.explain: Each text color on every surface Paseo paints it on, held to the same floors as the twelve fixed themes: 7:1 for body text, 4.5:1 for everything in the chat.

settings.languageDescription: The language of this plugin's screens and of the custom theme's name. The twelve fixed themes keep their names.
